title: Director of Origination - Patriot Hydro
description:
Overview:

**About Patriot Hydro:**

Patriot Hydro owns and operates 39 hydroelectric power generation projects across 10 states and six ISO markets, totaling approximately 311 MW. The company focuses on safe and reliable operations, responsible stewardship of its facilities, and disciplined commercial management of the portfolio.

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Origination will lead the contracting and commercialization of energy and related products from Patriot Hydro's existing hydroelectric fleet, with primary emphasis on New England. The position will develop customer relationships, identify bilateral opportunities, structure and negotiate transactions, and move opportunities from initial outreach through execution. The role requires strong knowledge of ISO New England and NYISO power markets, renewable energy products, and the commercial risks associated with variable hydrology and unit-contingent generation.

Working closely with finance, asset management, operations, legal, and regulatory personnel, the Director will develop contracting strategies that improve revenue certainty and portfolio value while remaining consistent with each facility's operating profile, license requirements, and risk limits.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute origination strategies for energy, renewable energy certificates and other environmental attributes, capacity, and ancillary services where applicable.
* Build and maintain relationships with investor-owned and municipal utilities, competitive suppliers, community choice aggregators, corporate buyers, energy marketers, public agencies, and other potential counterparties.
* Originate, structure, negotiate, and close power purchase agreements, renewable attribute sales, hedge transactions, and other bilateral arrangements for existing hydroelectric facilities.

title: Data Center Engineer, Reliability & Infrastructure Management – Compute Supply
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

#### **About the Role**

As an engineer on this team, you'll sit at the intersection of IT and facilities. You'll build the power models, availability models, topology and load management requirements that operate more efficiently against our physical envelope. Your work will directly shape which sites we lease, what SLAs we sign, how far we oversubscribe, and where workloads are placed.

#### **What You'll Do**

* **Topology and load management.** Own the power and cooling topology of our fleet as a living dataset, validate it and its telemetry against how the buildings really behave, and define how load management behaves under failure across chips and capacity providers, from requirements through commissioning and incident support.
* **Reliability modeling.** Build and audit availability models of data center electrical and mechanical systems, define Cloud availability zones and failure domains, from a single site to the whole fleet.
* **Power modeling and load forecasting.** Build models of power draw from chip to rack to facility, by workload and hardware generation, and use them to set capacity planning targets, design envelope, and load forecasting.
* **Partner diligence.** Work with data center developers, operators, cloud providers and chip vendors to drive design improvements and hold them to SLA-grade performance, with technical diligence on their architectures, reliability studies, rack power specifications and operator interfaces.
